Ivy (People Ops): quick plan for a 'Surprise Spot Awards' pick-up table next Thursday. goal: 10 $40 awards + 40 sticker sheets. need volunteers, budget OK, and a 2-line comms blurb.
Marco (People Ops): I can run the table 11:45-1:15. happy to do quick manager checks on approvals.
Jules (Office Ops): table reserved in Lobby B. I'll order a small card holder and a sign.
Priya (People Ops): form draft ready: nominee name, recipient email, short reason (100 chars), manager confirm checkbox, anonymous toggle. link: https://forms.gle/spotpilot
Hannah (Finance): budget: 10*$40=$400 + stickers $60. use GL 4210-people-fun. invoice and receipts required. pre-approve up to $600.
Ivy (People Ops): eligibility: all FT and contractors >90 days. anonymous nominations allowed but need payout contact. we'll include country field for intl payout flags.
reward-bot: Nomination form created at https://forms.gle/spotpilot - 0 responses. Use /rewards to see history.
Priya (People Ops): volunteers: Marco + me for the table, Jules will set up sign. need one more for printing and scanning receipts.
Jules (Office Ops): I'll print the sign and bring a laminator. drop art in #design-requests by EOD.
Hannah (Finance): note: non-US contractors may need gift cards different vendor. flag early.
Ivy (People Ops): timeline: open noms Mon 9am, close Wed 5pm, managers approve Thurs 9am, table Thurs 11:45-1:15. final steps: confirm sticker order, run form, and finalize comms blurb.
Marco (People Ops): :raised_hands: for volunteer printing. I'll also draft the 2-line comms and share here.
